name: Keystead
summary: A smoked-glass app for a rental home investor, with a live skyline of every home you own
about: A complete nine-page app for someone who owns and buys rental homes. Each home gets a drawn photo, a tenant, a loan and a ledger, and the portfolio shows up as a skyline where taller buildings are worth more and lit windows mean the home is let. It also has accounts with a freezable maintenance card, transfers with a review step, a mortgage planner and a deal analyzer, in a light and a dark smoked-glass theme.
how: Watch the skyline rise on Portfolio, hover a building for its numbers and click it to open the home
Switch the value chart between 12M, 3Y and 5Y to see it morph
Add, edit or delete homes and tenants, record rent and send reminders
Filter, sort and search the rent ledger, change a category or add an entry and watch the charts update
Move money between accounts with a review step, freeze the card and set its monthly limit
Drag the extra-payment slider on Mortgages, or test a new home in the Deal analyzer and save it as a prospect
